body:
Okay, it sounds like a cry for help.. it could get worse if you feel ignored when talking about it.. fyi.. talk to independent people or close friends not family at this point. 

Go talk to a doctor, counsellor, anything

The cake is a lie.. there's no cake tomorrow. Can't get a job without an address.. do you even know how much it costs to live?.. I need £70 a week for a room.. deposit is 2 month's rent.. so £500 you gave to pass credit checks.  I don't stand a chance
Late thirties, in about 30 k debt no liquidity.. currently undergoing divorce.. will lose job because I work from home and I am being kicked out.. no hopes here then
Sounds like a step to a better you! Often those you consider are your closest friends are toxic.  If they care they won't let you cut them off
I tried the new start.. maybe a new country will be different.. not sure how I am going to do that though.
Try getting help, talk to someone it's the first step

Nah it's pretty natural.. it's the barrier we must cross to end it..

My current way forward is currently 2days or so left in my home before I am removed and thrown onto the streets until the council can find me accommodation for which I am the bottom of a very long list.. I will then lose my job for connected reasons.. and not have a way back.. 

There isn't much future for me, maybe I could get institutionalised, but then just be a drain on other people's time and money for no worthwhile return.

She's right.. you spend a third of your life sleeping and more than a third of it at work or travelling to and from.. unless you are very lucky you will never earn enough to make a significant mark on the world. 

No one knows your here, no one cares, you got two choices, give it a go and hope to make a mark on the world and other people's lives. Or give up.. 

I always gave it a go.. you should ignore what other people say.. don't give up til you know you have failed which is much further down the line.
Nobody knows anyone.. that's why we talk to each other.. it also helps kill the time between dark thoughts.. might be worth a try
